model: XY moderator/liner FEM response fields + 1D axial helium energy/friction + selected RZ fuel/clad FEM; file-based one-way OpenMC heating transfer
limitations: Constant assumed YH2 conductivity 10 W/m/K and Al2O3 6 W/m/K; not validated irradiated properties
Prescribed parallel flow split 17.5% auxiliary; no plenum/orifice pressure-balance solution
Hydraulic-diameter heat-transfer closures; no resolved ellipse CFD
Friction pressure losses only; no manifolds/spacers/acceleration losses
Peripheral heat allocated to outer-ring cells; peripheral solid temperatures and full-core peak are unresolved
Reflector/absorber heat and cooling excluded from active thermal model
No two-way reactor temperature feedback; cell profiles at prescribed nominal neutronic temperatures
Monte Carlo heating statistics recorded separately; thermal systematic uncertainties are not a statistical confidence interval
